title: SEiPV-Net: An Efficient Deep Learning Framework for Autonomous Multi-Defect Segmentation in Electroluminescence Images of Solar Photovoltaic Modules
mechanism: Lightweight encoder-decoder on the 24-class Pratt data; compares weighted CE, weighted squared Dice and weighted Tanimoto losses with custom vs equal class weights.
adaptation: Replace the house soft Dice on crack/inactive with weighted Tanimoto, optionally extend to weak classes; keep architecture.
min_experiment: Arm house + weighted Tanimoto vs house, 5 seeds; crack IoU, inactive IoU, mIoU_rob; kill if no metric moves beyond noise.
evidence: R: abstract only (full text unavailable): custom class weights beat equal; claims better mIoU, F1, Dice than DeepLabv3+, PSPNet, U-Net on 24 classes. Per-class numbers not retrieved.
prior_overlap: Lovasz/Jaccard metric losses listed as untested; Tanimoto is in that family. Open.
